id: Would you like to take Hawlucha with you?
en: Would you like to take Hawlucha with you?

id: \bYou look like you need some cutting-edge power.
en: \bYou look like you need some cutting-edge power.
it: \bMi sembri uno a cui serve una potenza... tagliente.

id: \bCome again when you need some more.
en: \bCome again when you need some more.

id: \bI was hoping you would let me win.
en: \bI was hoping you would let me win.

id: \rSerena: \PN! What are you doing here? I thought you were doing gym battles?
en: \rSerena: \PN! What are you doing here? I thought you were doing gym battles?
it: \rSerena: \PN! Che ci fai qui? Pensavo fossi impegnato con le sfide in Palestra!

id: \rYou're on the way to one right now. Oh that makes sense. I've just been wandering around. Not really sure what I'm supposed to do on a journey.
en: \rYou're on the way to one right now. Oh that makes sense. I've just been wandering around. Not really sure what I'm supposed to do on a journey.
it: \rStai andando proprio a una di quelle adesso? Ah, ha senso. Io me ne sto solo andando in giro. Non so bene cosa dovrei fare durante un viaggio.

id: \rI guess we could have a battle. It's a nice distraction.
en: \rI guess we could have a battle. It's a nice distraction.
it: \rPotremmo fare una lotta. È una bella distrazione.

id: \rYou were amazing. I wish I could be just as good as you with my own talent.
en: \rYou were amazing. I wish I could be just as good as you with my own talent.
it: \rSei stato fantastico. Vorrei essere brava quanto te con il mio talento.

id: \rThere's no helping it for now though. I'll see you soon \PN. I need to go think on what to do.
en: \rThere's no helping it for now though. I'll see you soon \PN. I need to go think on what to do.
it: \rPer ora non ci posso fare niente, però. Ci vediamo presto, \PN. Devo riflettere su cosa fare.
\rHo aiutato ad allenare Gurkinn e Korrina.
